scripts.lint: eslint src tests e2e e2e-multiplayer server && tsc --noEmit
scripts.screenshot: npm run build && playwright test e2e/screenshot.spec.ts
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run screenshot && node scripts/check-verify.mjs
scripts.verify:multiplayer: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.multiplayer.config.ts && node scripts/check-verify-multiplayer.mjs
